user.title: Adaptative Climate
user.description: Create an adaptative climate entity. Choose a source climate entity for each mode; a mode without a source is not shown. The same entity can serve several modes. Without a heat/cool mode entity, the heat/cool mode uses the heat and cool entities.

data.name: Name
data.min_gap: Minimum gap between heating and cooling targets
data.min_phase_duration: Minimum time in heating or cooling before switching (heat/cool)

data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Room temperature shown by the entity. Without a heat/cool mode climate entity, the heat/cool mode switches between the heat and cool climate entities using it. Leave empty to use the temperature of the climate entities.
data_description.sync_modes: Optional. These modes share their fan and swing settings. A mode without a climate entity is ignored.
data_description.min_temp: Optional. Leave empty to follow the minimum of the climate entity in use. Can only raise it.
data_description.max_temp: Optional. Leave empty to follow the maximum of the climate entity in use. Can only lower it.
data_description.min_gap: Minimum gap between heating and cooling targets
data_description.min_phase_duration: Optional, in minutes (10 by default). Without a heat/cool mode climate entity, the heat/cool mode stays this long in heating or cooling before switching to the other one by itself. 0: switch at once. A change of the targets switches at once.

error.min_max_invalid: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum temperature.
error.self_reference: An Adaptative Climate entity cannot be used as a source.
error.no_source: Choose a climate entity for at least one mode.
error.mode_not_supported: The selected climate entity does not support this mode.

abort.invalid_yaml: The YAML configuration of this entry is invalid. Check the logs.
